title: Cloud security posture
heading:
How secure is your
cloud environment?
lead: Eight quick questions across identity, configuration, data and monitoring show how strong your cloud security posture is, and where to focus first.

items.name: Identity & access
items.q: Is cloud access least-privilege with MFA on admin accounts?
opts: Role-based access with MFA on privileged accounts.
Least privilege everywhere, strong MFA, and just-in-time admin.

items.name: Configuration
items.q: Are cloud misconfigurations detected and fixed?
opts: Regular configuration reviews against a baseline.
Continuous posture management with automated detection.

items.name: Data protection
items.q: Is data encrypted and are storage buckets kept private?
opts: Unclear, some data may be exposed.
Encryption plus checks that storage is not public.
Enforced encryption, key management, and no public exposure.

items.name: Logging & monitoring
items.q: Do you have logging and alerting across your cloud?
opts: Logs exist but are not reviewed.

items.name: Network exposure
items.q: Is your cloud network segmented and its exposure controlled?
opts: Flat, with services exposed to the internet.
Zero-trust style segmentation and minimal exposure.

items.name: Workload security
items.q: Are servers, containers and functions kept patched and hardened?
opts: Automated patching, hardening and image scanning.

items.name: Backup & recovery
items.q: Can you recover cloud workloads and data after failure?

items.name: Shared responsibility
items.q: Is it clear who secures what between you and the provider?
opts: Clear, governed model with owners for each area.
